text:
elaine: Quick sync — I'm landing the docs PR that replaces the old auditlog examples. Need a short, approved TTL + CLI example before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

samir: can you paste the final JSON sample you want in the docs? i updated the SDK snippets but left the CLI example generic.

elaine: thanks — want to show three things: 1) sample audit event row (jsonl), 2) an ri CLI export command for last-30-days, 3) recommended retention wording for SOC2 section. keeping it concise.

ben: my only ask: call out tenant scoping in the sample event (so customers know how to filter). short example ok.

samir: ok here's a compact JSONL sample (one line per event) — plz paste into the docs snippet:```json
{"ts":"2026-02-05T12:34:56Z","event_type":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"acme-corp","actor":"user:alice","resource":"model/gpt-4x-infer","meta":{"tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":18}}
```

elaine: perfect. adding a note: "tenant_id present so org-level exports can be filtered".

maria: legal: suggest we avoid absolute language like 'we delete after X' — better to frame as default retention with contract/legal-hold exceptions. also confirm whether exports created by customers are retained separately.

lex-legal: drafted phrasing suggestion for the docs: "Default audit log retention is 90 days. Customers may request extended retention via their contract. Legal holds and regulatory requests may override deletion policies; exported snapshots created by customers are under customer control and subject to their retention processes." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

ben: that reads fine to me. maybe add one sentence clarifying privileged logs (auth changes) are kept longer by default (180 days).

maria: yes, privileged logs -> 180 days is good. also add note about PSKs / credentials never stored in plaintext in logs.

elaine: will incorporate: short bullet list in the SOC2 retention section.

samir: CLI example for the export — draft:```bash
# export last 30 days of tenant-scoped audit events
ri audit export --tenant acme-corp --from "2026-01-04" --to "2026-02-03" --format jsonl --out ./acme-audit-30d.jsonl
```

elaine: nice. i'll paste that under "Exporting audit data (CLI)".

samir: SDK note: for quick dev verification we added tiny helpers in the ruby and go SDKs, here's a one-liner for each to read a jsonl file and count model.invoke events:
```ruby
# ruby example (docs/snippets/ruby/audit_count.rb)
count = File.foreach('acme-audit-30d.jsonl').count { |line| line.include?(\"event_type\":\"model.invoke\") }
puts count
```
```go
// go example (docs/snippets/go/audit_count.go)
// minimal: read file and check substring
```

ben: small nit: put the SDK snippets in separate files in the repo so we can link them. avoid embedding long code inline in the page.

elaine: will add snippet links and short inline code samples only. linking to files: docs/snippets/ruby/audit_count.rb and docs/snippets/go/audit_count.go.

maria: for compliance FAQ, can we add a short Q/A: "Can customers extend retention?" -> "Yes, via contract; contact your account manager."

lex-legal: add this sentence to the FAQ: "We will not alter customer exports; exported snapshots are considered customer data." Good to be explicit.

deploy-bot: PR 482 merged to staging at 3176543288 by @elaine :white_check_mark: 

elaine: merging to prod once legal okays the exact retention phrasing (lex-legal + maria). i'll push one more commit with the bullet list and links.

samir: i also added a tiny unit test in docs repo that validates the jsonl sample parses (docs/test/test_audit_snippet.py). please don't forget to run it in CI.

elaine: noted. thanks all — final todo for me: update PR with lex-legal sentence, add privileged logs bullet (180d), add CLI and SDK snippet links, run tests, then merge. ping me if anything else. :thumbsup:
